text:
alex_k: Quick heads-up — we're pre-flighting capacity for the Q3 feature launch. Need cross-region quota bumps (GPUs + networking) and a concrete headroom/burst plan for Dedicated pools. Target date: 2026-04-15.

maria_s: Can you drop numbers and which cloud accounts/projects?

alex_k: Using prod-dedicated (project: redwood-prod-dedicated) and staging-dedicated for canaries. Rough asks below — these are conservative but include a spot buffer for burst: 

```
Quota requests (per-region / per-project):
- us-west1: A100 quota current=24 -> request=72 (reserve 40, burst buffer 32 spot)
- us-east1: H100 quota current=8 -> request=48 (reserve 30, burst buffer 18 spot)
- europe-west1: mixed (A100/H100) current=12 -> request=36 (reserve 20, burst buffer 16)
- global static IPs (EIP) current=32 -> request=128 (we need IPs for load balancers + canary NAT)
- regional ENI/Network interfaces per VPC current=64 -> request=256 (pods + mgmt agents)
- Subnet secondary IP ranges / NAT gateways: increase concurrent static NAT flows 2x

Timeline: submit support tickets this week, approvals expected 3-5 business days if cloud-support engages. Need final confirmation by 2026-04-10 to schedule reservations.
```

samira: That A100/H100 split makes sense. Cost note: reserving 40 A100s vs relying on on-demand will change our burn. We should model committed vs on-demand mix. Suggest commit to 60% baseline capacity and use on-demand/spot for the rest.

irene_w: +1. Also call out quota scoping: some clouds enforce per-region AND per-project GPU SKU quotas. We need to ensure the increase is applied to the correct project (redwood-prod-dedicated) and to our billing account redwood-ops-prod.

alex_k: Good catch. I'll open separate quota requests per project and attach billing account. Also opening a single cloud-support ticket with the aggregated numbers so they can fast-track cross-region increases.

infra-bot: Ticket created: CLOUD-58921 — "Quota increase request: prod-dedicated GPU + EIP + ENI". Assigned to cloud-support. SLA: 72h triage. Link: https://cloud-support.example/CLOUD-58921

maria_s: For Dedicated pool sizing — proposal: reserve enough GPUs for 70% of expected QPS (p99 latency SLOs) and keep 30% as elastic burst. Why 70/30? Because our batching and caching reduce per-token GPU time; baseline must cover steady-state to get unit-cost targets.

alex_k: Agree. Updated short forecast (tokens / hour) below — this maps to GPU-days and costs.

```
Forecast snapshot (weekday peak):
- Estimated inference qps: 120k requests/hour
- Avg tokens per req: 120 -> ~14.4M tokens/hour
- Effective tokens/sec per A100 (with batching & quantized model): ~60k tokens/sec
-> Needed A100s baseline = ceil((14.4M / 3600) / 60k) ~ 7 GPUs for baseline per heavy pool region. We inflate by x4 for multi-tenant and throughput headroom -> reserve 28 A100s in us-west1.
(We added attenuation for cold cache and canary margin to get to earlier numbers)
```

samira: Can we use preemptible/spot for the burst buffer? That will save cost but needs fallback path if spots evaporate. Our runtime supports automatic fallback to smaller model variants — we should encode that in rollout.

alex_k: Exactly. Plan: Dedicated pool = committed + autoscaler that can spin spot instances. If spot not available, fallback to hosted model variant (lower cost, lower perf). That keeps app online with graceful degradation.

irene_w: Also request increasing API quota for instance-creation rate and concurrent IPs — create quota ticket entries for: 'instances per region', 'CPUs', 'GPUs by SKU', 'static IPs', 'regional forwarding rules'. Cloud often blocks blasts of instance creations otherwise.

alex_k: Added to ticket. I'll paste the final request body here before submitting. Please review.

```
Final request payload (to cloud-support):
- Projects: redwood-prod-dedicated, redwood-staging-dedicated
- Billing account: redwood-ops-prod
- Quota changes:
  * us-west1 GPUs (A100-v4): 24 -> 72
  * us-east1 GPUs (H100): 8 -> 48
  * europe-west1 GPUs (mixed): 12 -> 36
  * Static external IPs: 32 -> 128
  * Regional ENI / network interfaces: 64 -> 256
  * Instances create rate: 10 -> 100 per minute
  * Forwarding rules per region: 10 -> 40
- Justification: Q3 product launch requires baseline reserved capacity + spot burst to meet 99th percentile latency SLOs while keeping unit costs within target. We can share traffic curves and forecast doc on request.
- Needed by: 2026-04-15
```

maria_s: LGTM. I will run finance impact: committed cost vs expected saved token-cost from batching and longer-lived KV cache. Share draft with me and I'll loop in FP&A.

infra-bot: Support ticket updated with comment: "attached forecast.xlsx and rollout plan". Status: Pending action from cloud-support.

samira: One more ops ask — create a short playbook for low-spot-availability: steps for autoscaler override, model-fallback chain, and emergency re-route to hosted. I'll draft it and put in ops-runbooks.

alex_k: Thanks — action items: (1) alex_k opens ticket & attaches forecast (done), (2) maria_s to run cost modeling, (3) samira to draft runbook, (4) irene_w to confirm project/billing scoping, (5) infra to follow-up with cloud-support SLA.

irene_w: I'll also validate IAM roles for quota request edits — only cloud-owners can accept certain quota changes. Might need a cloud-owner to cosign.

alex_k: Noted. I'll ping @cloud-owners in the ticket.

maria_s: ETA for finance card: 48h.

alex_k: Great — I'll post updates here as the ticket advances. :rocket:
